REPLACE-CHECK

The check runs with `-W error::DeprecationWarning` and passes (exit 0, 13 passed), yet the second run without that flag clearly shows 2 warnings still being emitted. The `-W error` flag should have caused those warnings to become errors and fail the test, but it didn't—which means the check isn't actually detecting the presence of the warnings it claims to gate. This check would report "pass" both before implementation (as shown) and after, so it cannot discriminate done from untouched. A replacement check needs to verify that warnings are actually absent, perhaps by running without `-W error` and asserting the summary line shows "0 warnings" rather than "2 warnings".
